reviews.text: I received all the support I needed there to arrange my pet's burial. The staff were helpful and assisted me with care during the most painful time. The veterinarian is a sweetheart and very competent.
I highly recommend them, they're amazing!
Cristal looked wonderful. Thank you so much for your kindness and for taking such good care of her! I will definitely bring her back again!
Excellent! We were apprehensive because we'd never used Taxi Dog before. Everything was quick and efficient, and the little guy came back looking great, haha. You've won us over!

I loved the service. I left my cat Pablo there for 7 days, as I needed to take a trip. He was fine, and I received updates from him every day.

Great, I recommend it.
I always take my pet there for a bath and the service is very good. They are attentive. I highly recommend them!
Our experience was great!! We were happy and grateful for the care given to our kitten!! We can only say thank you!!
Very attentive receptionist.

I really liked the service and attention offered to my cat (Francisco) and me.
He stayed at the pet hotel and received daily updates about his stay and health.
He underwent a veterinary evaluation and the medication was very effective, in addition to the dedication and care of Dr. Miriam.
Lu is wonderful, she takes very good care of my daughter.

My experience and that of my pets was great. This is the second time they've stayed at Pet a Vet, and the service is excellent. They are always very attentive and concerned about the pets' well-being. The driver was also super careful and helpful. I highly recommend them ❤️
Excellent service and quality, I really like it!!!

Dr. Isa saved my Catarina from a terrible tracheal collapse; I will never have enough words to thank her for that. I am very grateful that the Bela Vista clinic has such competent professionals as Dr. Isa. ❤️

I really liked it! Daniela, who assisted us, was super attentive and a great employee! She managed to fit us in the next day, but that's because I confused the location with another establishment; otherwise, it would have been the same day! My CVI (Certificate of Violence Against Women) came out in 5 days! Thank you so much to everyone who helped us! I can only express my gratitude!!

My kitten stayed at the cat hotel for a week while we were traveling. The staff is super friendly and check-in was very easy. We received photos and updates every day. Our cat arrived home super happy and calm 😁.
Excellent service.
Excellent service!

Hello Adolfo! Thank you for your feedback. It's very important for us to reach other pets with credibility and trust.

Until next time.

Hello Ana! Thank you for your feedback and for your trust in our work.

We look forward to seeing you again in the future!
Excellent. Specialized professionals to take care of your pet. Bella and Juju's favorite place for bath time. On-site parking.
It was great, except they got Mimi's name wrong, but they sent her photos. This last stay was even better. I loved it.

Great place, my dog ​​Duke loved it.
The attendant Gi was very attentive.
My dog ​​is elderly and needs a lot of care, and she was careful.

I was there with my kitten who needed stitches. I found the service to be humane and welcoming. On top of that, I thought the approach was very honest. They explained the cost of everything they would do and didn't add unnecessary tests and procedures to inflate the bill. I really liked it!!!

Hello William! Thank you for your feedback.

We look forward to seeing you again soon!

Wonderful! I rescued my kitten from the street and he stayed at Pet a Vet for 15 days. During all that time, Shiva (my cat) received no shortage of love and care. The entire team was super attentive and caring, both to me and to my kitten. Shiva arrived home completely healed, clean, and happy. I am so grateful to everyone.

Hello, “Isaa Reis”, how are you?

We received your review on our profile and, when searching for your visit to Pet a Vet, we found no record of either in-person service or any online conversation we may have had.

Could you have confused us with another location? We are located on Rua Fidalga, Vila Madalena, in São Paulo.

Concerned about your experience with us, we kindly ask that you review whether your review refers to us and contact us to explain the reason for your review, if applicable.

If you realize it was a mistake, please remove your review, as it is not accurate and negatively impacts the perception of our services for other clients.

We await your response!

Pet a Vet Team.

Wonderful veterinary clinic, clean, polite and very helpful staff.
I had a situation with my pet where she needed follow-up care and I received all the support from the Doctor, today I can enjoy life with her in safety and always count on the clinic.

I recommend it.

Responsible professionals ♡
They work with love for what they do*
Fair price.

Thank you for your feedback, Carlo!

We hope to see you at the next opportunity!

It was a desperate situation; I had no idea what to do until someone recommended this company to me. From the very first contact, the support, the care, and the respect were excellent. Congratulations on the service and welcoming atmosphere. I highly recommend them.

Excellent service!

Jhonny is pure joy when I take him to Pet a Vet. Just saying "let's go to Pet a Vet" makes him euphoric, he immediately wants to grab his leash and run to the car! Bathing, grooming, and boarding are highly recommended!
Very good, I highly recommend it, the staff is very attentive to the pets.

Thank you so much for all the stars! They help other people discover our work too.

Until next time!

Always helpful and polite!
Thank God, my boy is well taken care of by everyone, but it's especially special when it's Doctor Will 😍 …

Hi Thais! Thank you so much for leaving your review on our Google page.
It increases our credibility and encourages others to learn about our work.

See you next time!

Bye!
Great place, amazing staff!

Thank you for your feedback, Mariely!
Count on us whenever you need us.

They are always very careful; I leave my cat at the hotel every time I travel. You can see the affection and care in every video; they ask the vet to check whenever they find any changes. The service is exceptional. I recommend them without hesitation.

I wanted to express my gratitude and love to the entire Pet a Vet team who took care of my kitten for over a month with so much love and attention while I was traveling. They are very attentive and gave me updates every day, informing me of everything that was happening and constantly sending me photos and videos. Tchelo loved the holiday camp and I was able to work and take care of my father while he enjoyed his vacation at Pet a Vet. Thank you to the whole team ♥️
